tasks.goal: Deliver persistent, audited and authorized release-window APIs.
input_facts: Window state derives from four minute-precision dates
Project and window code are immutable

Access only rel_release_window and rel_window_change_log

Allowed updates record reason and before/after values

tasks.rollback: Disable window routes and retain window and audit records.
stop_conditions: Approved overlap semantics cannot be implemented deterministically
MySQL locking introduces an unresolved race
escalation_conditions: Formal project authorization is newly required
Permission codes conflict with platform semantics

tasks.goal: Deliver persistent release applications, snapshots, scenario derivation, conflicts and audited state actions.
input_facts: One application has one subsystem and unique delivery units

Do not access workflow or attachment private data
